name: feedback-triage
description: Complete GitHub and GitLab feedback triage with evidence-based value scoring.

interface.shortDescription: Validate and prioritize PR and MR feedback.
interface.longDescription: Collect every page of GitHub PR or GitLab MR feedback through gh or glab, validate each claim, score its value, and process worthwhile fixes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Process all feedback on this PR or MR, validate each claim, and handle worthwhile fixes and threads.
